tagline: House-roasted espresso, flaky viennoiserie and all-day sourdough brunch plates in Shoreditch E2.

heroImage.alt: Sourdough avocado toast with poached eggs, flaky almond croissant and flat white on oak table at Redchurch Espresso & Kitchen

services.name: House Double Espresso
services.description: Washed Brazilian & Kenyan blend — dark chocolate, roasted hazelnut and bright blood orange.

services.name: Flat White / Cortado
services.description: Double ristretto with silky steamed estate dairy or barista oat milk at no extra charge.

services.name: Cold Brew Tonic
services.description: 18-hour single-origin cold brew poured over crisp tonic water and fresh orange peel.

services.name: Twice-Baked Almond Croissant
services.description: Filled with toasted marzipan frangipane, flaked almonds and light icing sugar.

services.name: Pistachio & Orange Morning Bun
services.description: Crisp laminated dough rolled in Sicilian pistachio sugar and zest.

services.name: Smashed Avocado, Poached Eggs & Chilli on Sourdough
services.description: Two free-range poached eggs, lime-crushed avocado, Aleppo pepper and toasted seeds.

services.name: Turkish Eggs (Cilbir)
services.description: Whipped garlic Greek yoghurt, poached eggs, brown butter paprika oil, dill and grilled sourdough.

services.name: Harissa Halloumi & Roasted Pepper Ciabatta
services.description: Chargrilled Cypriot halloumi, sweet roast peppers, baby spinach and rose harissa mayo.

gallery.alt: Almond croissant, avocado and poached eggs on sourdough and flat white served in the window at Redchurch Espresso
gallery.caption: Brunch plates cooked to order daily until 3pm on Redchurch Street.

gallery.alt: Morning espresso counter lined with warm laminated croissants and cardamom buns in Shoreditch
gallery.caption: Oat milk included free on every espresso drink — zero surcharge.

reviews.author: Samira B.
reviews.text: The Turkish eggs and twice-baked almond croissant are unreal. Fast service even in the 8:30am commuter rush.

reviews.author: Ollie T.
reviews.text: Properly dialled-in espresso and sunny window tables right off Shoreditch High Street.

about: Redchurch Espresso & Kitchen pairs East London speciality coffee with a proper morning bakery and hot sourdough brunch kitchen. Drop in at 7am for a quick flat white or grab a window table for poached eggs and pastries.
